description: Pune airport operations have resumed after an Indian Air Force Sukhoi 30 MKI aircraft experienced an undercarriage failure during a hard landing, blocking the runway. Repair work was completed on a war footing, with departure operations starting at 7:30 AM and arrivals at 8:00 AM. Several flights were cancelled due to the incident.
title: Pune airport resumes ops hours after IAF fighter jet's 'hard landing' - what had gone wrong?

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Royal Challengers Bengaluru faces Delhi Capitals with a key question surrounding Virat Kohli's role. After an ankle injury, Kohli played as an Impact Player against LSG, scoring 49. While expected to be fit, his workload management could see him reprise the Impact Player role. RCB, in strong form, aims for a top spot.
title: Will Virat Kohli play as Impact Player today vs Delhi Capitals?

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: United States President Donald Trump has declared Israel is prohibited from conducting further airstrikes in Lebanon. This statement surprised Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. Meanwhile, Iran announced it is reopening the Strait of Hormuz to commercial shipping. This move signals potential progress in broader United States-Iran diplomacy. Despite the ceasefire, some military activity was reported.
title: 'Netanyahu was stunned when he saw Trump's post': Did US 'prohibit' Israeli strikes on Lebanon?

author: TOI CITY DESK
description: TCS clarified that an individual wrongly identified as an HR manager in the Nashik controversy was a process associate with no recruitment involvement. The company denied reports of the unit's shutdown and reiterated its zero-tolerance policy for misconduct, while also stating no internal complaints were received. An independent inquiry, supported by external agencies, is underway.
title: TCS Nashik case: Woman who was referred to as HR manager held no leadership responsibilities

author: TOI BUSINESS DESK
description: Global markets surged Friday as easing West Asia tensions spurred a broad risk rally. Wall Street benchmarks hit record highs, led by small-cap stocks, as falling oil prices boosted confidence. Investors anticipate an end to the conflict, with US President Trump expressing optimism for a swift resolution and a deal on uranium.
title: US stock market at record high after Trump says ‘Hormuz is open’

description: The US Treasury Department has issued a new license extending a waiver for global buyers to purchase Russian oil shipments already at sea until May 16. This decision reverses earlier statements and aims to manage energy market volatility, despite criticism from lawmakers who argue it supports economies engaged in conflicts.
title: Russian oil sanctions: US extends waiver for cargoes already at sea

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Akshay Kumar's 'Bhooth Bangla' has stormed the box office, securing a massive Rs 23.90 crore worldwide debut on its opening day. This impressive performance has dethroned Ranveer Singh's 'Dhurandhar: The Revenge' after its four-week reign. The horror-comedy's strong opening positions it among Akshay Kumar's top post-pandemic releases.
title: 'Bhooth Bangla' opens to strong Rs 23 crore worldwide debut; ends 'Dhurandhar 2' reign

author: TNN
description: In light of recent allegations regarding sexual harassment and religious coercion at the Nashik unit, TCS's CEO K Krithivasan has reported the establishment of an oversight committee to evaluate the situation. Initial investigations revealed no formal complaints filed, yet suspended employees are currently facing scrutiny.
title: Twist in TCS Nashik case: No harassment or conversion plaint, says IT firm

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Second round of US-Iran talks to ease Middle East tensions is expected in Islamabad, with Pakistan offering full support. Pakistani Army Chief met Iranian Parliament Speaker as diplomatic efforts intensified. US President Trump indicated he might visit Pakistan if a deal is finalized.
title: Next round of US-Iran peace talks expected from Monday - what we know so far

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Amazon is re-entering China with a new strategy, focusing on logistics to support Chinese sellers exporting globally, particularly to the US.  After its previous marketplace failed against local giants, the e-commerce giant has opened a Shenzhen hub offering storage, customs, and shipping services. This move aims to cut seller costs and compete with rivals like Temu and Shein.
title: Amazon is returning to China after it was 'killed' by JD.com

author: JOY SENGUPTA AND SANDIP DIGHE
description: Pune airport's runway closure following an Indian Air Force aircraft incident caused significant flight disruptions Monday night. An IAF Sukhoi 30 MKI reportedly experienced an undercarriage failure during a hard landing, blocking the runway. Over 30 flights were diverted or cancelled, leaving passengers facing confusion and delays. Efforts are underway to clear the runway.
title: IAF fighter jet’s ‘hard landing’ shuts Pune runway, affects scores of night flights

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Jasprit Bumrah is experiencing an uncharacteristic lean patch in IPL 2026, failing to pick up a wicket in five matches. Former India cricketer Irfan Pathan suggests Bumrah's excessive use of slower deliveries, accounting for 44% of his bowling, is impacting his effectiveness. Pathan advises increasing pace and reducing slower ball percentage for better results.
title: Bumrah loses cool, hurls run-up marker in frustration amid horror run - WATCH

author: NISHIKANT KARLIKAR
description: The father of AIMIM corporator Sahar Sheikh has refuted allegations of a fake caste certificate, calling the controversy a politically motivated stunt. Yunus Sheikh stated his daughter is being targeted due to her political growth and promised to provide authentic documents to counter the claims. He also defended Sahar's attendance at an IPL match, dismissing public criticism.
title: 'Fake' caste certificate row: AIMIM corporator Sahar Sheikh’s father denies charges

author: AMISHA PANDEY
description: NFL star Josh Allen and actress Hailee Steinfeld welcomed their baby daughter, sharing the joyous news on Thursday. Just a day later, the new parents made a dazzling appearance at Josh's best friend Sam Darnold's wedding. The couple, radiating happiness, celebrated with fellow NFL players, even sharing baby photos, proving they can balance new parenthood with social commitments.
title: Josh Allen, Hailee Steinfeld glow after welcoming first child

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Gujarat Titans showcased exceptional fielding, taking nine catches and a run-out to dismiss Kolkata Knight Riders for 180. Mohammed Siraj, instrumental with 2/23 and two catches, credited rediscovered rhythm and self-analysis for his resurgence.  He emphasised the importance of mental clarity and sticking to successful processes, highlighting the team's positive environment.
title: ‘I’m the best fielder!’: Siraj’s cheeky quip after GT’s catching masterclass vs KKR

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Dhurandhar 2, starring Ranveer Singh, has achieved a remarkable global milestone, crossing Rs 1,742 crore worldwide in just 30 days. While domestic collections are slowing, the film's extraordinary cumulative run places it as the second-highest-grossing Indian film globally, trailing only Baahubali 2. This achievement equals Pushpa 2's lifetime total in a fraction of the time.
title: 'Dhurandhar 2' matches 'Pushpa 2' record; hits Rs 1,742 crore mark on day 30

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Kolkata Knight Riders are in a deep slump, losing their fifth match and sitting at the bottom of the IPL 2026 table. Despite a coaching change, results remain elusive. Former England batter Kevin Pietersen has predicted a return for ex-coach Brendon McCullum next season. Captain Ajinkya Rahane acknowledged the tough losses but highlighted positive individual performances.
title: KKR's next coach decided? Kevin Pietersen makes bold prediction

author: TYSION PRABHU
description: In a heart-wrenching event on the winding Valparai-Pollachi ghat road, a van carrying a group of tourists from Kerala tragically fell into a steep gorge, resulting in the loss of nine lives, including five dedicated teachers. The group was on their way home after a day of exploration when the driver lost control on a treacherous curve.
title: 9 tourists from Kerala killed as van plunges into gorge in Tamil Nadu

author: VINEET RAMAKRISHNAN
description: Lokesh Sathyanathan’s 8.21m jump in Fayetteville last month broke his own national record and made him the fourth Indian to win an NCAA Division I title. Now third on India’s all-time list, the feat follows years of injuries and personal loss, with his journey driven by his mother’s last words and his father’s constant presence.
title: ‘This is what my mother wanted’: Behind Lokesh Sathyanathan’s NCAA-winning 8.21m leap

author: AVISHEK KUMAR
description: A seven-year-old girl was allegedly kidnapped and sexually assaulted while sleeping at a Ghaziabad construction site.  CCTV footage shows the child with an unidentified suspect.  The family, originally from Madhya Pradesh, reported the incident, and police are actively working to identify and apprehend the perpetrator. This marks the third such case involving a minor in the district recently.
title: At site where father works as guard, 7-year-old girl kidnapped and raped in Ghaziabad

author: SAMAD HOQUE
description: A 33-year-old American Express executive was found dead by suicide in his Gurgaon flat on Friday. His wife, who flew in from Mumbai after he stopped answering calls following a fight, discovered the scene. The couple, married four months ago, faced marital strain due to their differing work locations. Police are investigating the incident, noting the deceased was under stress.
title: American Express executive found dead in Gurgaon; wife finds body inside flat

author: TNN
description: A Delhi court has asked the Enforcement Directorate to respond to a plea by actor Jacqueline Fernandez to become a witness in a Rs 200 crore money laundering case. Fernandez is accused of receiving gifts worth up to Rs 7 crore from alleged conman Sukesh Chandrashekhar, a charge she denies.
title: Sukesh Chandrashekhar case: Jacqueline Fernandez seeks to turn approver

author: NISHIKANT KARLIKAR AND ABHILASH BOTEKAR
description: Nashik Crime Branch is searching for a 26-year-old TCS employee in Mumbra, Thane, accused of religious harassment. Her husband, questioned by police, stated she returned to Nashik. The woman, reportedly pregnant, is seeking anticipatory bail. The National Commission for Women has formed a fact-finding committee to investigate the allegations.
title: TCS Nashik case: Cops reach Mumbai in search of TCS staffer, question her husband

author: KUSHAGRA DIXIT AND KHUSHI BHUTA
description: Delhi experienced its hottest day of the season at 41 degrees Celsius on Friday, only to be unexpectedly cooled by intense thunderstorms and heavy rain. The sudden downpour caught residents and the IMD off guard, causing significant traffic disruptions across the city. Forecasters anticipate continued high temperatures over the weekend.
title: Delhi sees 3 seasons in a day: Hazy start, mercury hits 41°C, pounding rain
